content:
The task failed due to a specific string matching error in the HWPX section XML where a required project phase value was missing or incorrectly formatted.
The verifier failed with an AssertionError in 'test_required_values_present_and_placeholders_removed' within '/tests/test_outputs.py'. Specifically, the assertion 'assert f"{value} (1개월)" in combined' failed because the expected string '파일럿 운영 및 안정화 (2027-01) (1개월)' was not found in the combined XML content of section0.xml and section1.xml. While two other tests passed, this regression dropped the reward from 1.00 to 0.00.
